_meta.title: Krea 2 Turbo GGUF checkpoint — injected from the UI picker
Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder (fp8 = text-only; bf16 needed for moodboard reference images)
qwen_image_vae.safetensors — the correct pairing per Comfy-Org/Krea-2
Optional prompt-adherence booster — strength 0 is a no-op, safe to always wire in. `model` is rewired by the backend to point past any LoRA chain when LoRAs are supplied.

Positive prompt — plain encode (no chat-template wrapping). The backend swaps this node for TextEncodeKrea2 only when moodboard reference images are attached, since that's the only node with image slots — TextEncodeKrea2's chat-instruction framing measurably softens Qwen3-VL's interpretation of the prompt, confirmed against a known-good standalone workflow.
Negative — zeroed rather than a real encode (turbo/distilled convention; irrelevant at cfg=1.0 anyway, matches the verified reference workflow)
16-channel empty latent — matches Krea2's latent space
Sampler — turbo defaults are a best guess, tune against real output
Save result — backend splices a ReActorFaceSwap chain in front of this node's `images` input when faces are supplied
